pages.en:
“————————”

My body feels like lead.

Waking is far from pleasant, and a faint headache pulses behind my eyes.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
My body feels heavy.
My awakening comes with a headache.

pages.ja:
「……昨日の傷のせいかな。右腕、まだ微かに痛むし」
ぼんやりと呟きながら体を起こす。
時刻は午前六時を過ぎていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「……昨日の傷のせいかな。右腕、まだ微かに痛むし」
ぼんやりと呟きながら体を起こす。
時刻は午前六時を過ぎていた。
pages.en:
“…Maybe it’s yesterday’s injury. My right arm still hurts a little.”

I murmur to myself as I sit up.

It is past six in the morning.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I wonder if it’s because of the wound from yesterday. My right arm’s still hurting.”
I murmur while getting up.
It’s past six o’clock.

pages.ja:
「まず、今日くらい朝飯作らないと……！」
布団から飛び出し、パパッと着替えを済ませる。
藤ねえと桜には朝練がある。
二人は六時半には家を出るから、急いで支度にかからないと間に合わない。
pages.jaRuby:
「まず、今日くらい朝飯作らないと……！」
布団から飛び出し、パパッと着替えを済ませる。
藤ねえと桜には朝練がある。
二人は六時半には家を出るから、急いで支度にかからないと間に合わない。
pages.en:
“At the very least, I have to make breakfast today…!”

I spring out of bed and change as quickly as I can.

Fuji and Sakura have morning practice. They will leave at six thirty, so unless I hurry, breakfast will not be ready in time.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Crap, I should be making breakfast…!”
I jump out of my futon and change instantly.
Fuji-nee and Sakura have morning practice.
They’ll be leaving here around six-thirty, so I won’t make it unless I hurry.

pages.ja:
二人を送り出して、セイバーと食後のお茶を飲む。
朝は慌ただしく過ぎていって、気が付けば七時をとっくに過ぎていた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
After seeing the two of them off, I drink tea with Saber.

The morning passes in a rush. Before I know it, seven o’clock is long gone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
After I see them off, I drink tea with Saber.
Time flies by and it’s past seven o’clock before I realize it.

pages.ja:
「それじゃ行ってくる。留守番よろしくな、セイバー」
「はい。シロウも気を付けて。凛の助力があるとは言え、無茶はしないように」
「ああ、昨日で懲りてる。敵を追いかける時はセイバーの力を借りるよ」

pages.en:
“I’m heading out. Look after the house, Saber.”

“Very well. Take care yourself, Shirou. Even with Rin’s assistance, you must not act recklessly.”

“I learned my lesson yesterday. If we have to pursue an enemy, I’ll ask for your help.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’m going now. Take care while I’m gone, Saber.”
“Yes. Please be careful yourself as well. Do not do anything reckless, even if you may be with Rin.”
“Yeah, I learned that yesterday. I’ll ask for your help if I’m to go after an enemy.”

pages.ja:
セイバーに片手をあげて玄関を後にする。
朝の空気はいたって平穏。
だがこれから向かう学校は、今までとは違うモノだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
I raise one hand to Saber and leave the house.

The morning air is perfectly peaceful.

But the school awaiting me is no longer the place it was before.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I wave goodbye and leave.
The morning air is peaceful.
But the place I’m heading to isn’t normal anymore.

pages.en:
“——All right.”

I steel myself and descend the hill.

If Tohsaka is acting in earnest as a Master, I must accomplish something worthy of standing beside her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“All right.”
I get myself mentally ready as I go down the hill.
Tohsaka’s acting like a Master, so I should act as one too.

“——!”

Heat floods my head, and I march straight toward Shinji.

“Shinji, you——!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
I don’t need to think.
I run straight to Shinji.
“Shinji, you!”

pages.ja:
「やあ衛宮。どうしたんだよ、今朝は随分と物騒じゃないか。なに、僕が休んでる時に何かあったの？」
「何かあったじゃない。おまえ、美綴に何をした」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Good morning, Emiya. What’s gotten into you? You’re awfully menacing this morning. Did something happen while I was away?”

“Don’t ask me what happened. What did you do to Mitsuzuri?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hey, Emiya. What’s going on? You’re looking pretty dangerous. Did something happen to you while I was gone?”
“Shut up. What did you do to Mitsuzuri?”

pages.ja:
「美綴
？ ああ、綾子ね。なんでも家出してたらしいじゃん。僕も今朝道場で聞いたよ。昨日、新都の方で見つかったんだってね」
何がおかしいのか、慎二はクスクスと笑う。
その目は、美綴を嘲笑っているようにしか見えなかった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Mitsuzuri——? Oh, you mean Ayako. I hear she ran away from home. They were talking about it at the archery hall this morning. Apparently they found her somewhere in Shinto yesterday.”

Shinji chuckles, though nothing about the story is amusing.

His eyes seem to mock Mitsuzuri herself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Mitsuzuri? Oh, Ayako. I heard she ran away. I heard about it in the range this morning. So she was found in Shinto, huh?”
I don’t know what’s funny, but Shinji laughs.
It looks like he’s sneering at her.

pages.ja: 「……とぼけるな。美綴と最後に会ったのはおまえだろう。その時、あいつに何をしたかって訊いてるんだよ、俺は」
pages.jaRuby: 「……とぼけるな。美綴と最後に会ったのはおまえだろう。その時、あいつに何をしたかって訊いてるんだよ、俺は」
pages.en: “…Don’t play innocent. You were the last person to see Mitsuzuri. I’m asking what you did to her.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…Don’t play dumb. You’re the last one that talked to her. I’m asking you what you did to her then.”

pages.ja:
「はあ？ 何をしたかって、ただの世間話だけど？
それよりさ、聞いたかい衛宮！ 綾子のヤツ、そこいらの路地裏に転がってたんだぜ？ フラフラでさ、制服もボロボロだったって話さ。
いや、何があったかしらないけどさ、ちょっと聞き捨てならないよな。普段から偉ぶってるあいつがさ、どんな風に捨てられてたか興味あるよね」

“What? What did I do? We made small talk, that’s all.

“More importantly, did you hear, Emiya? They found Ayako sprawled in some back alley. She could barely stand, and her uniform was in tatters.

“I don’t know what happened to her, but you can’t hear something like that and not wonder, can you? She’s always strutting around like she owns the place. Aren’t you curious what she looked like lying there, discarded?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh? We only chatted for a bit.
More importantly, did you hear about it, Emiya!?
Ayako was fucked up in the back alley! It must’ve been rough! I heard her eyes were spaced out and her uniform was messed up.
They found Ayako collapsed in the back alley! I hear she was all dizzy, and her uniform was messed up.
Well, I don’t know what happened, but it’s not something I can ignore, right? I’m kind of curious how that conceited girl got trashed.”

“————”

…I struggle to keep my clenched fist at my side.

Did he spread a story like that himself?

Mitsuzuri is a girl. She may carry herself the way she does, and everyone else may see her that way, but however strong she appears, she is still a girl.

No matter how tough she is, having a story like this spread about her could make it impossible even to hold her head up.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…I clench my fists.
Did he go around and tell everyone such a story?
Mitsuzuri is a girl. Everyone thinks she’s strong, but she’s still a girl.
So no matter how strong she is, it’ll destroy her if such a rumor is spreading.

Did he spread it knowing exactly what it would do to her?

By yesterday, he had turned details that should have been known only to the people who found her into an entertaining piece of irresponsible gossip——!
pages.mirrorMoon:
And he still spread the rumor in spite of that?
He took a secret and spread it irresponsibly!?

“—Shinji, you——!”

I seize him by the shoulder.

“Stop glaring at me. I told you I don’t know anything. If you accuse people on the strength of your own selfish assumptions, you’ll come to regret it, Emiya.”

Shinji shakes off my hand and takes his seat.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shinji, you…!”
I grab his shoulder.
“Don’t glare at me like that. I said I don’t know anything about it. You’ll regret it if you hit me for selfish reasons.”
Shaking my hand off, Shinji goes to sit down.

The bell rings for homeroom.

“——————”

Everyone else is sitting down. I cannot remain standing.

I give Shinji one final look and, for now, have no choice but to return quietly to my desk.

“!”
I can’t stay standing when everyone’s sitting down.
I glare at Shinji one more time and head to my seat.
